tasks.label: install-impeccable-user-skill
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('impeccable-src-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString()); git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable $tmp | Out-Null; $src=Join-Path $tmp '.agents/skills/impeccable'; if (!(Test-Path $src)) { throw "Missing source folder: $src" }; $dstRoot=Join-Path $HOME '.agents/skills'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dstRoot -Force | Out-Null; $dst=Join-Path $dstRoot 'impeccable'; if (Test-Path $dst) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $dst }; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force $src $dst; Write-Output "Installed to $dst"
